comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
There are no battles in this quest, so gearing up for it will not be necessary.

Quest Guide: Go to Tenochtitlan, north-west area. Talk to Cuauhtemoc.
After you finish talking to him, proceed and go to the south-east veracruz area, head to your right and click on the Large Boulder. From there, go to the other Large Boulder (Northern-most part of the map) and click it as well. After you've done that, head to Veracruz and speak to the High Priest (Between the Port Official and the Rest Area).

Head back to south-east veracruz and north of the Table Rock (Entrance to Tenochtitlan) will be a Sailor npc. Talk to him. Head from there to the first Large Boulder I mentioned. Go through the text and when you appear back in south-east veracruz, return to Veracruz. From the gates, head straight and you will see three npcs. Talk to them and the quest will be complete.
